summary: Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch and TensorFlow inference, and the relevant unit tests pass. Changes: src/sagemaker/image_uris.py adds _is_graviton_inference, which routes pytorch/tensorflow inference requests on Graviton families (c6g, m6gd, r7g, t4g, etc.) to a "<framework>-graviton" config. New configs: src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch-graviton.json (1.12.1, repo pytorch-inference-graviton) and tensorflow-graviton.json (2.9.1, repo tensorflow-inference-graviton), both py38, container tag ubuntu20.04-sagemaker, registries 763104351884 across 22 commercial regions. Verified: both spec examples return the expected URIs, and the ml.c5 standard path is unchanged. Tests (with a temporary mock shim in /tmp/mockshim, outside repo and venv): tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_retrieve.py and tests/unit/test_fw_utils.py, 86 passed; tests/unit/sagemaker/tensorflow/test_estimator_init.py and tests/unit/test_pytorch.py, 1107 passed, 224 skipped. Not run: the broader tensorflow and model suites from the original request. No new unit tests cover the Graviton path, registries outside us-west-2 are unverified, and nothing was committed.
